title: Randomized-base GT transfer, revised STNFS core (LA pad 1.10, exact prices, line sieve to 2^45.5 with trial division below 2^30 and first-pass line records, 99.9% ECM, slack 60, merge weight 300, descent probability integrated over measured norm sub-cells with a re-searched plan, 2-SE relation input, modelled success 0.50 against the 0.39 claim, row tail over the 7 occupied owners): 124.382061069061269

claims.statement: For the production bls12-381-g1-ecdlp-plain target, the algorithm in proof.md returns the canonical scalar x for uniform T=[x]P0 (infinity included) with success at least 0.39 (modelled lower bound (1-2^-128) x 0.50 - 2^-48; the gap above 0.39 is a disclosed margin for H5 model error, DESCENT.md), conditional on the disclosed H1-H5 (with H4u) of source-core.md. It maps the problem to GT by z=e(T,Q0) against a freshly randomized base g=e(P0,Q0)^b, which gives exactly the uniform (nonidentity base, independent target) input distribution, converts both into the STNFS tower by the charged field map of field-map.md, computes a=log_g(z) with the GT STNFS core and returns ba mod r after checking [ba]P0=T. The core is the recover-Q core of submission e3940d11 with the revisions R1-R18 of REVISION.md: 99.9% per-prime ECM (403 curves per side), record walk to 2^64 with [2^63, 2^64) charged at 2x, line sieve from 2^11 to 2^45.5 with record walk above, trial division below 2^30 and first-pass line-hit records over [2^30, 2^45.5), relation sub-region theta=190/500 sized so the descent's 2^63.79 relations hold at a 2-SE lower bound on the yield (with a collection guard), cofactor slacks (297, 233), records routed by direct chunk scatter at 10.3 instructions per record, ungated recovery, linear algebra fully priced as in our recover-Q 711418d3 with the row tail counted over the 7 occupied block owners (1,350 per row; N < 7 x 2^56), line/record kernel prices at their exact logged differential quotients with a 0.01 table-lookup shift (21 instructions per sparse entry with the 11-instruction +-1 loop, unit share >= 0.88 under heuristic H4u; row tail with every reduction mod r compiled loop-free; 420 per lone 9-limb reduction; matrix pad 1.10 over the measured non-increasing N/U trend 2^12..2^18 at merge weight 300, part of H3) with block Wiedemann (23, 4), canonical-work allowance 1.06905 (>= 1 + 2.00 SE), descent missing-log inputs 745.9/498.9 at 2^63.79 relations, per-cell semismooth probabilities integrated over 24 measured cf-quantile sub-cells and 10 boot deciles (same +23/+6/+4 shifts as the sextiles, boost capped 4x/1.5x) with the plan and boot re-searched, two-log meter 2^116.1806 (Markov 0.49557); its upper-rounded complete ledger is below 2^121.058691 dense-Fp12 units (C=20,000) with modelled success at least 0.50 (claim 0.39). Total classical work, including all preprocessing, both logarithms, failures, the field map, pairings, sampling, verification and output, is 10 x (1001/1000) x 2^121.058691 + 2^80/2000 < 2^124.382061069061269 G1 reference units (C=2,000); the 1001/1000 is a reserve on the whole core instruction ledger covering sub-half-ulp quoted-decimal residuals (recomputed collection moves 1.000029x, ledger 1.000027x; both machine-checked). Peak storage below 2^106 bytes; no advice and no amortization. Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Fast run ({}): recomputes region, count products, yield/margin, work SE/allce, ECM schedules, LA kernels/prices/occupancy, N/U trend, exact prices, table shape, shift coverage, residuals, recovery, success, ledger, G1 conversion and bijections. {"descent": true} also reruns descent, node counter and repeats (~10 s). {"unit_entries": [k, seed]} measures H4u at scale 2^k. {"source": name} prints a kernels_asm.b85 section.
